name: Homing Missile
description: Locks a missile onto an enemy up to %cast_range% tiles away. It lands after %delay% turn for %damage% damage, plus %aoe_damage% to enemies beside them.
details: It tracks the target wherever they go, so running is no escape - the tile it will hit is marked on the board.
Cleansing the lock before impact shoots the missile down.

upgrade.summary: Fires %missiles% missiles - a stunning one first, the warhead a turn behind.
upgrade.description: Locks %missiles% missiles onto an enemy up to %cast_range% tiles away. The warhead lands after %delay% turns for %damage% damage, plus %aoe_damage% to enemies beside them.
details: The lighter missile arrives first, after %second_missile_delay% turn, dealing %second_missile_damage% damage to the target and every enemy beside them and stunning them all for %second_missile_stun% turn.
It plays no favourites - the locked target takes the same %second_missile_damage% as its neighbours, with no bonus for being the one aimed at.
Both track the target wherever they go, so running is no escape - the tile they will hit is marked on the board.
Cleansing the lock before impact shoots down whatever is still in the air.
